items.text: Three years ago on October 7, Hamas attacked Israel, resulting in about 1,200 deaths and 251 hostages. The Nova music festival in a non-residential area was one of the first places targeted. This event was reported by Babak Es-haqi from Iran International.

A student stated that Azad University of Rudehen criticizes female students' dress code instead of improving academic quality. The university charges high tuition fees. The student's voice was reprocessed with artificial intelligence for security.
Following a shooting by military forces in Bandar Abbas, a fuel transporter vehicle overturned and caught fire. In this incident, a disabled fuel transporter lost his life.
Workers at the Iran-Break Rasht factory have gone on strike due to unpaid wages and insurance. The protest began yesterday and continues today. They have gathered in front of the factory entrance.

Clashes between Yemeni government forces and Houthis around the Bab al-Mandab Strait have intensified. Mohammadjavad Akbarin highlighted the importance of this area for maritime security and the global supply chain. He also stated that the Islamic Republic has destabilized countries and positioned the Houthis against Yemen's legitimate government.
The head of the Masal Environmental Protection Department announced the issuance of a fine for a person accused of animal abuse in this county.

Etemad newspaper reported that housing expenses account for 40% of the monthly expenditures of the urban middle class and 48% for the urban poor. Arzoo Karimi stated that renting is no longer only a problem in large cities, and rent increases in these cities are also significant. This report was published on World Tenants' Day.

The venue of a ceremony attended by Ali Daei and his wife in Qom was sealed by order of the prosecutor. The reason for sealing was the wife's failure to observe the hijab. A legal case has been filed against the organizers.

The Kahkeshan Ghadir banquet hall in Qom was sealed due to the presence of Ali Daei and his wife without mandatory hijab at an event and was accused of violating norms. A judicial case has been filed against the organizers of the event.

Alireza Dabir, head of the Wrestling Federation, spoke about football managers and said wrestling is a red line for him. He stated he has no interest in being involved in football and advised football officials to clarify their position. Dabir also criticized the football managers' performance over the past 20 to 30 years.

Iliya Bakhshaei, a student at Yazd University and detainee of the 1404 protests, was released from Evin Prison after his retrial request was accepted and he posted bail. His prison sentence has been suspended and the case has been sent for re-examination to a peer branch. This occurred on Monday, 13 Mehr.

A video of a local mourning ceremony for Alireza Raeisi has been released. Alireza Raeisi was one of the detainees from the December 2025 protests in Isfahan. He was executed by the order of the Islamic Republic judiciary.

Mohsen Khalasi, a citizen of Sabzevar, was sentenced to 15 years in prison by the first branch of the Revolutionary Court of Sabzevar. Five years of this sentence have been suspended for five years. His charges include cooperating with hostile governments and intentional arson of properties.

Marco Rubio has warned since 2015 about the risk of Iran following North Korea's path. The Islamic Republic is developing missiles and military capabilities to potentially acquire nuclear weapons. The US will continue military and political pressure on Tehran to prevent this.
The 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded to Henri B. Kagan and Kensō Soai for their research on 'chirality' and how one mirror-image form of molecules becomes dominant in the chemistry of life.

Araz Soleimani, a law student and barber from Chalus, was killed by suppressors on January 8. His mother fed pigeons on his birthday and said her son was "of the lineage of flight." This video was published on social media.

Morteza Kazemian from Iran International said that US officials emphasize they will not allow the Islamic Republic to acquire nuclear weapons. He described this as a sign of the superior position of the US against the Islamic Republic. He also said that the US focus is more on Iran's nuclear activities than on destabilizing regional waters.

Iran International audiences expressed concern about the militarization of schools and the presence of military or security forces in educational environments. A ninth-grade student from Karaj said that a war tag has been made for each student. This issue was discussed in an interview with Baharan Azadi.

Saeed Naderi, a resident of Vahidieh, was released from Qezel Hesar prison in Karaj after posting a one billion toman bail. This release took place on Tuesday, 14 Mehr. Harana News Agency reported this news.
Mikel Arteta signed a new contract with Arsenal until 2030. He described recent successes as just the beginning. His salary has increased in the new contract.

Spain defeated Croatia with a spectacular comeback. England beat the Czech Republic 3-0 with Harry Kane's outstanding performance. Kane scored two goals, bringing his total international goals to 89 and tying the record with 125 international appearances.

Russia launched one of its largest attacks on Ukraine, firing about 70 missiles and numerous drones. Volodymyr Zelensky stated that at least 11 people were killed and energy infrastructure was targeted. Ukraine responded by striking two oil facilities and a military training field in Russia.

Yahya Sarea, the Houthi spokesperson, announced drone attacks on King Khalid Airport in Riyadh, causing flight disruptions. Missile attacks were also reported on airports in Abha and Khamis Mushait and three military bases in Jizan and Asir. Saudi officials have not yet responded to these claims.

Javad Nekounam, the coach of Tractor, said in a press conference before the match against Esteghlal that both teams are strong contenders in Iranian football. He spoke about Esteghlal and their new players and emphasized that he will do his best for Tractor's success. Nekounam also commented on last season's championship and wished Esteghlal success in Asia.

Mohammad Reza Naqdi announced that the range of the Islamic Republic's missiles will be increased according to battlefield needs. He stated that the limited range of weapons is due to policy, not technical reasons. He also said the Strait of Hormuz is closed and illegal routes there are being blocked.
The deputy prosecutor of Shahr-e Kord announced the closure of three commercial units. One of these units was a cafe. The reason for closing the cafe was stated as enhancing moral security.

Ali Abdollahi, Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces of the Islamic Republic, stated on the anniversary of the October 7 attack that the heroism of the resistance front's martyrs will continue and will mark the end of Israel. He described the operation as beyond Israel's expectations and disruptive to the enemy's calculations. He also said the attack shifted the resistance front's strategy from defensive to offensive.

The Administrative Justice Court annulled the equestrian federation election held on Azar 5, 1404. The ruling was issued by branch 36, and the Ministry of Sports and Youth can appeal it. This election was the third assembly of the equestrian federation in three years.

A number of Iranians living in Spain gathered on October 7 in front of the Israeli embassy in Madrid. They paid tribute to the victims of the October 7 attack. They also expressed their solidarity with the people of Israel.

Kamil Mohammadi, a resident of Mashhad and nephew of Narges Mohammadi, was arrested by security forces on Thursday, 9 Mehr. After his arrest, he was taken to an interrogation center and then transferred to the Revolutionary Court and prison in Mashhad.

US Secretary of State Marco Rubio says Iran has missed multiple opportunities to reach a nuclear agreement with the United States and continues to spend vast sums on terrorism, weapons, and Hezbollah. He described Iran's economy as collapsing and blamed the ruling hardline Shiite clerics. Rubio also reiterated Washington's stance on preventing Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons and said Donald Trump has destroyed Iran's military capability and a large part of its military industry capacity.

A report from the Parliament Research Center shows that urban poverty affects half of Tehran. This report was released amid increasing poverty in Iran and the government's ineffective plans. The assessment was provided by Arash Azarmi from Iran International.

Gideon Sa'ar, Israel's foreign minister, called the Islamic Republic and its affiliated forces a threat to Israel. He said a clock is set in Tehran counting down to Israel's destruction. He also warned that enemies still seek to destroy the country.

Hadi Abbasian, a detained protester in Shirvan, has been sentenced to death on charges of rebellion. His Instagram activities and videos of protests were cited in his case. In a video, he stated that he will not back down from his protest.

One of Seyed Ahmad Seyed Abdollahi's cases was closed by the issuance of a discontinuation order by the General Court of Borujen. The case was related to charges of propaganda against the Islamic Republic system. He is serving his sentence in prison for another case.

Hadi Abbasian, a detainee of the National Revolution in Shirvan, has been sentenced to death on charges of "rebellion" under Article 287 of the Islamic Penal Code. The Revolutionary Court of Bojnord considered his activities as armed uprising against the regime. He denied accusations of connections with Israel and labeling protesters as terrorists.

Masoud Pezeshkian congratulated Vladimir Putin on his 74th birthday in a phone call. He emphasized the continuation and strengthening of bilateral cooperation between Iran and Russia. Pezeshkian considered the ongoing strategic cooperation to be in the interest of both countries.

Majid Bahiraei, one of the detainees of the National Revolution in Nahavand, sent a message from prison. In his message, he said the honor of Iran and Iranians belongs to the children of Iran. This message was read from prison on August 19.

Jerusalem Post reported that senior Israeli defense officials warned members of the security cabinet on Sunday about the possibility of an Iranian miscalculation and missile fire toward Israel amid continued US pressure and Iran's worsening economic situation. The officials also said the ban on Iranian airline flights that began two weeks ago has increased the effectiveness of the siege. They said US actions have had significant consequences for Iran's economic situation, adding that the situation is deteriorating and getting worse every day.

On the third anniversary of the October 7, 2023 attack, a group of Iranians gathered in Brussels in front of the Israeli embassy. The gathering was held to commemorate the victims. Simultaneous memorial ceremonies are also taking place in various European cities.

The Israeli army announced that Mohammed Tamos, a sniper from Hamas's military wing who was introduced as a rescue worker, was killed in an Israeli attack. Israeli forces identified and targeted two Hamas members after they left Kamal Adwan Hospital. The Israeli army claims Hamas uses hospitals for terrorist activities.

Hamid Nikvan, director of the North Miami Beach Water and Sewer Department, received the "Most Innovative Project of the Year" award from the International Water Association in Glasgow. The award was presented at the World Water Congress and Exhibition. This event is one of the most prestigious specialized events in the water sector globally.
The death sentence of Omid Goodarzvand Chegini, a 37-year-old protester arrested during the December 2025 protests, has been confirmed on appeal. He is imprisoned in Choubinder Prison in Qazvin.

Bahareh Aghaei, a lawyer imprisoned in Qarchak Varamin prison, has been sentenced to 20 years in prison. Her case involves supporting December protesters, attending the 40th-day ceremony of Sepehr Shokri, and providing legal aid to families seeking justice. This news was announced by Shirin Ebadi's Telegram channel.

A group of Iranians living in Belgium protested against the issuance and execution of death sentences in Iran in Brussels. They expressed their support for Prince Reza Pahlavi. This was shown in videos received by Iran International.

Children with autism and their families in Iran face heavy treatment costs and lack of government support. Only three thousand out of 150,000 autistic children in Iran have been identified. Ayah Daris has addressed these issues in a report.

Some participants in military training in Iran, including Basijis and clerics, have taken weapons home after the courses. Reports indicate that these trainings ended without a clear mechanism for returning the weapons. The Islamic Republic has intensified militarization and weapons training programs in the country.

Alireza Sepahi, a detainee from the December protests and convicted in the Ali Khani Square case in Isfahan, was executed on Monday, October 5. A video of him singing has been released. This news was reported by Iran International.

Mohammad Reza Aref stated that the economy is the country's top priority and the government is seeking a fundamental solution to inflation. He mentioned that the country faces a shortage of 100 to 250 million cubic meters of gas this year, and 250 million cubic meters of gas capacity from Asaluyeh has been out of service due to war attacks. At least 100 million cubic meters of this capacity will be restored, and the government does not intend to cut gas supply to industries.

Reuters reported that last week the number of attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz reached the highest weekly level since the start of the US-Iran conflict. At least 12 attacks on tankers and gas carriers were recorded from October 6 to 13. The US Naval Intelligence Center described these actions as an effort by the Islamic Republic to maintain pressure on passing ships.

Donald Trump spoke by phone with Benjamin Netanyahu on the third anniversary of the October 7 attack. Trump said the other side will pay a heavy price for what they did. He also stated that the war against the Islamic Republic will end soon in some form.

Workers at the Chabahar petrochemical project reported several months of delayed salary payments and deductions for food, shoes, and work clothes. They demanded attention to wage claims, insurance status, and the contractor company's performance.

Iran provided 200 million dollars last month to Hezbollah to financially assist displaced Lebanese families affected by the war with Israel. Hezbollah plans to give about three thousand dollars to each family. Priority is given to families whose villages were destroyed or who cannot return home.

Mokhtar Alboshokeh, a political prisoner in Arak prison, has resumed a hunger strike since Tuesday, October 5th, due to officials' failure to transfer him to Sheiban prison in Ahvaz. He is currently held in the quarantine ward of Arak prison. Previously, he had also gone on hunger strike for the same reason and ended it after officials promised to meet his request.

Jaber Rajabi said the Islamic Republic made a miscalculation with the October 7 attack, expecting it to create a major political crisis for Israel. He added that Israel's response and support from various countries changed Tehran's calculations. According to Rajabi, the Islamic Republic has lost much of its regional standing after this attack.

Alireza Raeisi, a 21-year-old protester arrested in December 2025, was executed early Monday, October 4, 2026, in Dastgerd prison in Isfahan. Videos and images of the execution have been shared on social media. Alireza Sepahi was also executed alongside him.

Mehdi Shafiei and his 18-year-old son Mani were killed on January 9, 2026, in Qaemiyeh town of Islamshahr by government forces. A video shows their family's distress at their graves. This incident was reported by Iran International.

Iran's Foreign Ministry summoned the French ambassador over violent responses to student protests and human rights violations. The student protests in France began on September 17 and spread to other cities. French officials reported at least 190 students and 715 police officers injured.

Farzin Nadimi stated that Israel decided after October 7 to contain threats before they escalate into crises. Israel is rebuilding its security doctrine by creating buffer zones and strengthening its air force. Israel aims to maintain and enhance its military superiority, not to become a regional hegemon.

The UK Maritime Trade Operations reported that a tanker was attacked north of Qatar. Casualties have been reported in the attack. Authorities are investigating the incident and have warned ships to exercise caution.

An investigation by Iran International into hacked documents of Bank Parsian shows that the bank used its exchange to transfer millions of dollars abroad despite US sanctions. The Central Bank and other financial institutions also used Parsian Exchange to facilitate payments. The transactions involved multiple layers of Iranian and foreign banks, companies, and individuals.

Lionel Messi wrote on his Instagram after his farewell match that he misses wearing the Argentina national team jersey. He thanked his family and teammates and mentioned Diego Maradona. Messi said his football journey was full of joy and sad moments.

Isaac Herzog, the President of Israel, expressed gratitude to Reza Pahlavi for his message on the third anniversary of the October 7 Hamas attack. Herzog described Pahlavi's message as deep and meaningful and thanked him for his solidarity. Reza Pahlavi had expressed solidarity with the people of Israel and condemned the Islamic Republic in his message.
Mahan Mehrabi announced the death of her mother. Her mother was waiting for the return of her imprisoned son. Mahmoud Mehrabi has been in prison without leave for 1400 days.

A student sent a video showing the tearing of Khomeini's picture from textbooks and throwing them into the trash. The student states that Khomeini's true place and legacy belong in the trash. The student believes the Islamic Republic will fall and students will shape Iran's future.

The October 7 attack was a military shock and a national trauma for Israel, activating deep security and psychological fractures in society. It shattered the belief in absolute security and caused fundamental changes in societal priorities. The consequences of this event, especially regarding the future of Palestine and the region, have been analyzed.

Morad Vaisi stated that the Islamic Republic of Iran has paid 200 million dollars to Hezbollah Lebanon. This amount equals 810 million tomans for each of the 50,000 Lebanese households. This action took place amid Iran's severe economic difficulties.

Nader Ghazipour stated that Tractor club was gifted to Mohammad Reza Zanouzi. He said that Sepah Ashura, due to problems with the club, handed it over to Zanouzi. Ghazipour confirmed his role as an intermediary in this transfer.

Morad Vaisi, senior analyst at Iran International, commented on the difference in subsidy payments between Iran and Lebanon. He questioned why the Islamic Republic haggles over paying just one dollar more to Iranian people but easily gives much more to Lebanese families. He criticized this issue.

The World Bank in its latest forecast predicted that Iran's economy will shrink by more than seven and a half percent and the per capita income of each Iranian will decrease by more than eight percent. The bank also estimated Iran's annual inflation rate at 74 percent.

Ismail Baghaei, spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic, said Tehran has communicated its considerations and conditions for ending the war on all fronts and restoring security to the Persian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz to the other side. The response to US proposals will also be provided through mediators.

Cristiano Ronaldo reacted to Lionel Messi's retirement from the Argentina national team. He praised Messi's years of defending his country's jersey and expressed his respect. Ronaldo embraced Messi in his message.

Pete Hegseth, US Secretary of Defense, praised the crew of a US warship for their courage in the war with Iran and said the ship's mission was extended by his order. Defending the ship's performance, he said some media tried to portray it as a symbol of inefficiency, but the crew's performance is commendable. Hegseth emphasized that the US will not allow the Islamic Republic to obtain nuclear weapons.

Iran International's investigation reveals that Parsian Bank used its exchange office to transfer millions of dollars abroad despite US sanctions. Miad Maleki, former head of the US Treasury sanctions targeting office, emphasized that the entire financial sector of the Islamic Republic is under sanctions and focus should be on blocking the assets of trusts. He stated these networks are more important than the IRGC and Basij.

The Islamic Republic summoned the French ambassador over human rights violations. This action followed the French police's response to student protests. The contradictions in handling protesters in Iran and France have been highlighted.

Ali Khamenei called Yahya Sinwar a shining figure of resistance after his death and described the October 7 attack as an irreparable blow. This message is repeated on billboards in Iran and praised as a victory in the official narrative of the Islamic Republic. A program from Iran International discusses this topic.

A teacher with 18 years of experience stated that her annual salary is about 300 million tomans and criticized the $200 million aid given by Iran to Hezbollah. She said these aids come while Iranian people are struggling with poverty and inflation. She also pointed out the difference in aid given to Iranian soldiers and Hezbollah families.

A minibus carrying personnel of the 88th Armored Division of the Army was attacked by armed assailants on the Makran coast. One person was killed and three others were injured in the incident. The attack occurred during a shift change of the personnel.

Donald Trump, the President of the United States, stated in a speech in Texas regarding the war with Iran that this war "will end very soon" and described Iran as a "defeated country." He also emphasized America's role in oil transit through the Strait of Hormuz and said that rising oil prices are worth preventing Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons. Trump stated that he would never allow Iran to possess nuclear weapons.

Two American media outlets have reported that the Pentagon is preparing for a possible renewed attack on Iran. An order has been issued to CENTCOM to complete readiness for combat operations against Iran. The White House has also requested options for an attack before the midterm elections.

The director general of school renovation in North Khorasan announced that 130 schools need demolition and reconstruction due to deterioration. These schools constitute 7.5 percent of the province's active schools.
The manager and journalist of the Vana News website were found guilty by the press court jury and the fifth branch of the criminal court one of Tehran province.

Ehsan Sohrabi reported a shortage of insulin and difficulties for diabetic workers in accessing this medication. Patients have to visit multiple pharmacies and face quota limitations or pay out-of-pocket costs. He called for urgent action by the Ministry of Health to address this issue.
